mapper.select: SELECT bks.book_id as bookId, bks.book_title as bookTitle, bks.book_author as bookAuthor, bks.book_price as bookPrice, bks.book_summary as bookSummary, bks.book_cover as bookCover, gnr.genre_name as genreName, bks.book_stock as bookStock, bks.book_publisher as bookPublisher, bks.book_flag as bookFlag FROM books as bks JOIN genres as gnr ON bks.book_genre = genre_id WHERE bks.book_id = #{select_book_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart ( user_id, book_id, book_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{bookCount} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, book_id) DO NOTHING
